faqs.q: What's the difference between Ignition and Apex membership?
faqs.a: Ignition gives you core access to the Fireball Car Club community — exclusive events, member discounts, and early product drops. Apex is the elite tier: it includes everything in Ignition plus priority event access, premium member perks, and direct access to exclusive Apex-only experiences.

faqs.q: Can I upgrade from Ignition to Apex at any time?
faqs.a: Yes. You can upgrade your membership at any time from your account dashboard. The prorated difference will be applied automatically, and your Apex benefits activate immediately upon upgrade.

faqs.q: Do I need to own a specific type of vehicle to join?
faqs.a: Not at all. The Fireball Car Club is open to anyone who is passionate about car culture. Whether you drive a daily, a weekend project, or an exotic, you are welcome.

faqs.q: How do I access member-only events?
faqs.a: Once your membership is active, exclusive event invitations are sent directly to your account email. Apex members receive priority access and reserved spots before general member registration opens.
You can cancel your membership at any time from your account settings. Your benefits remain active until the end of your current billing period.

faqs.q: Who is the Fireball Academy training designed for?
faqs.a: The Academy is built for professional detailers, shop owners, and aspiring installers who want to earn Fireball certification and offer premium ceramic coating services. No prior coating experience is required — the program covers everything from fundamentals to advanced application.

faqs.q: How long is the training program?
faqs.a: The standard Fireball Academy program runs over two full days. Day one covers ceramic coating application and surface preparation. Day two focuses on product knowledge, business strategy, and the hands-on certification assessment.

faqs.q: What certification do I receive after completing the program?
faqs.a: Graduates receive official Fireball Canada certification, which authorizes you to sell and install Fireball ceramic coatings professionally. Certified installers are also listed in the Fireball installer network, helping clients find you directly.

faqs.q: What products will I work with during training?
faqs.a: You'll train hands-on with the full Fireball ceramic coating lineup — including Butterfly, Butterfly Graphene, Silla, and Devil's Blood — using the same professional tools used by certified installers across Canada.

faqs.q: Are seats limited for each training session?
faqs.a: Yes. Each session is intentionally kept small to ensure every participant gets direct, hands-on attention from the instructors. We recommend registering as early as possible to secure your spot.
